text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National council for environment pleads for partnership between citizens, businesses and government to tackle pollution.
- Cabinet meeting approves law shaping increase of minimum wage as result of social dialogue between businesses and unions in August.
- Struggling French airline Air Liberte, which operates in Morocco denies cancelling flights.
- Privatisation Minister Abderrahman Saaidi announces sale of 30 percent of the state's stake in Fertima, the main distributor of fertilisers.
- Parliament to start autumn session on Friday.
- National commission in charge of follow-up of social dialogue expected to announce moves to implement accord signed with unions over benefits in August.
- Visiting French MPs to tour Western Sahara.
